note: ANNIVERSARY. The third aircraft: 2016 authored a glider at every level of the game (six missions, a player prefab, level-select tables) and shipped it switched off at every level, so under hard rule 2 there is nothing to extract and every number here is new (DEV-145). Unlike the HoverJet and the JumpSeat, whose variants SCALE 2016's generated sheet, the glider carries its own absolute numbers in `tuning`, because no sheet has them. They moved here from the one course's `flightModel` when the glider was wired (DEV-399, AIRCRAFT-VARIANTS section 5, G1), as level-schema.ts had asked before a second course copied them. Three were CHOSEN (terminal dive 170 m/s, cruise 55 m/s, glide 7:1 at trim) and the rest SOLVED from them against 4 x 32 = 128 N of weight; sim/glider.ts's PROTOTYPE_GLIDER comment carries the solve and the measurements, and tests/unit/glider-mission.test.ts pins that copy to this one. NONE of it has been flown by a human: G4 is the headset session. One variant until G5, whose acrobat and speed are DESIGN targets re-solved into a tuning (section 3.3), never scales on these solved fields.

variants.name: Standard
variants.note: DEV-145's prototype, as tuned on a monitor. The hangar shows it as a one-table page (section 6.2's no-skip rule) until G5 adds acrobat and speed either side of it. The blurb is 2016's own design intent for the glider prefab: useGravity 1, maxSpeed 0.
